title: Scoped Device File Operations in Windows Workspace with cross-environment safety declaration

phases.objective: Verify exact device-scoped file create, copy, move, patch and rollback behavior with opt-in write approval, SHA fencing and no cross-root or Production mutation, pending independent live Staging certification.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated Local Connector operator with explicit local file-write approval
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Device Files Engine through Local Connector and Windows Device Workspace
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Bounded file operations reject traversal, secret paths, missing approvals, overwrites and mismatching SHA digests; no implicit Production release or credentials.
steps: Check the mounted directory is explicitly allowlisted and file operations reject symlink and traversal escapes.
Verify exclusive create/copy/move, approved optimistic patch and conditional rollback against expected SHA digests.
Confirm the desktop wiring preserves device identity and local approval isolation.
assertions: No file write without explicit local approval and no access outside the configured root.
Destination creation must be exclusive and SHA-bound operations must not overwrite unrelated changes.
Staging must be certified independently and Production mutation remains forbidden.
